Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Sections start with `.p2align 2`, which is the alignment llvm-mc gives RISC-V
code and not rsasm's default; see mips.txt. Linked with --no-relax.

GNU as and llvm-mc create `.data` before any section the source names, and
rsasm creates it when it is first used. A snippet with both says `.data`
first, so the sections come out in the same order.

=== hi and lo of a label in another section
        .text
        .p2align 2
        lui     a0, %hi(msg)
        addi    a0, a0, %lo(msg)
        lw      a1, %lo(msg)(a0)
        sw      a1, %lo(msg + 4)(a0)
        ret
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .space  0x1800
msg:    .word   1, 2

=== pcrel_hi and pcrel_lo in the same section
        .text
        .p2align 2
        nop
1:      auipc   a0, %pcrel_hi(target)
        addi    a0, a0, %pcrel_lo(1b)
        lw      a1, %pcrel_lo(1b)(a0)
        sw      a1, %pcrel_lo(1b)(a0)
        ret
        .space  0x900
target: .word   0

=== pcrel_hi and pcrel_lo into another section
        .text
        .p2align 2
here:   auipc   a0, %pcrel_hi(msg)
        addi    a0, a0, %pcrel_lo(here)
        ret
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .space  0x2810
msg:    .word   1

=== pcrel_lo naming an auipc behind it @ 0x10ffc
        .text
        .p2align 2
back:   auipc   a0, %pcrel_hi(data)
        nop
        nop
        addi    a0, a0, %pcrel_lo(back)
        ret
        .data
        .p2align 2
data:   .word   1

=== la, call and tail into another section
        .data
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        la      a0, msg
        call    helper
        tail    helper
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
        .p2align 2
helper:
        ret
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .space  0x1000
msg:    .word   1

=== jumps and branches into another section
        .option norvc
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        jal     helper
        j       helper
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
        .p2align 2
helper:
        j       entry

=== data across sections
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        ret
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .word   entry
        .word   entry - .
